church of st. vincent de paul marino thought for the day the global celebration on sunday, 18 october 2026, marks the historic 100th anniversary (centenary) of world mission sunday since its ofïcial establishment by pope pius xi in 1926. for this milestone anniversary, pope leo xiv has chosen the theme "one in christ, united in mission" . the theme emphasizes that mission is not reserved for a select few; rather, every baptized person is an active participant in bringing christ's hope to the world. the collection holds unique meaning for pope leo xiv, who served directly as a missionary priest and bishop in the underserved regions of peru before his election to the papacy in 2025. in his personal centenary video message , he shares how the prayers and generosity of past world mission sundays directly shaped and sustained his own missionary vocation. prayer bless all missionaries who bring your gospel to the ends of the earth. protect them in danger, strengthen them in faith, and fill them with joy. teach us to give generously from what we have, so that your hope and compassion may reach every corner of the world. church services marino:
